title: Stop returns before they happen
pitch: Spots the order bought in three sizes to send two back, answers the fit question before checkout, and scores each return for fraud.

evidence.claim: Shoppers were expected to return $849.9 billion of goods in 2025, 19.3% of online sales, and 9% of returns are fraudulent.
evidence.sourceName: National Retail Federation and Happy Returns, October 2025

gap: Return platforms handle the return once it starts. Preventing it, for stores below enterprise size, is barely served.
